records.rationale: Business ethical persuasion concerns transparent value communication and non-coercive customer decisions; communication ethical persuasion concerns argument construction, audience influence and rhetorical responsibility. Shared ethics, different task contexts and assessment.

Business operations quality control concerns process/product consistency and defect handling; leadership quality control concerns governance, accountability and team-level oversight. Related but different levels of analysis.

Electrical hazard recognition requires domain-specific understanding of shock, stored energy, isolation and equipment boundaries; practical-independence hazard recognition is broader scene awareness and safe escalation. Do not collapse specialist electrical risk into generic safety.

Finance budgeting concerns income/expense planning, allocation, forecasts and trade-offs; everyday consumer budgeting concerns routine spending, bills, comparison and household decisions. Shared arithmetic but different scope.

Body-science measurement validity concerns human measurement protocols, biological variability and instrument/observer limitations; research measurement validity concerns construct operationalisation, instrument validity and study design. Cross-domain methods transfer, not identity.

Photography framing concerns boundaries, crop, viewpoint and visual emphasis; rhetorical framing concerns how language and selection shape interpretation. Same term, different perceptual and communicative mechanisms.

Three-dimensional design spatial composition concerns volume, spatial relationships, structure and object/environment arrangement; artistic perspective/space concerns depiction of depth and spatial illusion on a representational surface.

Workflow prioritisation allocates personal attention across tasks and deadlines; leadership prioritisation allocates team capacity and strategic resources under stakeholder constraints. Shared decision logic, different authority and consequences.

Performance listening and musicianship concerns auditory attention to timing, pitch, cues and ensemble response; leadership active listening concerns interpersonal meaning, paraphrase, empathy and shared understanding. Some transferable attention habits, distinct assessments.

Performance audience awareness concerns live room feedback, stage presence and adapting delivery in real time; communication audience awareness concerns audience analysis, prior knowledge, needs and message design.

Language cross-cultural pragmatics concerns linguistic conventions, speech acts, politeness and contextual meaning across languages; communication cross-cultural pragmatics concerns broader intercultural interaction, norms, channel and relationship context.
